name: Girih Interlace in Lapis & Gold
promptTemplate: An Islamic geometric girih pattern of {{geometry_order}} with interlaced strapwork in {{strap_style}}, weaving over and under at scale {{pattern_scale}} with {{interlace_depth}} width and tracing at {{trace_speed}}.

strap_style.hint: Swap mineral glaze and metal sheen

pattern_scale.hint: Density of repeating girih star tiles

interlace_depth.hint: Girth of the woven ribbon straps

trace_speed.hint: Speed of continuous gold line tracing

listing.blurb: An Islamic geometric pattern: a star-and-polygon girih tiling drawn with interlaced strapwork passing over and under, lines tracing themselves on, in lapis and gold.
listing.prompt: An Islamic geometric pattern: a star-and-polygon girih tiling drawn with interlaced strapwork passing over and under, lines tracing themselves on, in lapis and gold. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
